title: Management Fee Invoicing Clause of the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Each billing period a contract held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program was invoiced for the management fee printed against the service model in force on the invoice day, reduced by the portfolio discount percentage the client's portfolio band yielded, and rounded to the nearest cent — that clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for the fee.

Where the service model changed part way through a billing period, the fee for that period was the fee of the model in force on the invoice day, with no proration carried out between the two models — that clause is likewise **no longer in force** and superseded by the current basis.

The annual escalation was applied to the management fee on the first invoice raised on or after each anniversary of the contract start date, and never mid-year — that clause is also **no longer in force** and superseded by the current basis. No figure of the current basis is given here.

**Clauses still in force.** A management fee is only invoiced while the contract stands mobilizing, active, suspended or in transition out. On a suspended contract the standby charge replaces the management fee for that period, and the management fee is not raised at all for it — this is read from the contract's own status on record, taken before the invoice is raised, for that contract alone.

On a cost plus basis or a fixed fee basis, the administration fee is charged on invoiced food cost in addition to the management fee; on a profit and loss basis, no administration fee is charged.

The monthly management fee, the annual escalation percentage, the administration fee percentage of food cost, and the management fee basis itself all remain those printed against the service model, and stay valid entries against each service model even though the clauses that once assembled them into an invoiced figure are superseded.

superseded_clauses: Each billing period the contract is invoiced for the management fee printed against the service model in force on the invoice day, reduced by the portfolio discount percentage the client's portfolio band yields, and rounded to the nearest cent.
Where the service model changed part way through a billing period, the fee for that period is the fee of the model in force on the invoice day and no proration is carried out between the two models.
The annual escalation is applied to the management fee on the first invoice raised on or after each anniversary of the contract start date, and never mid-year.
